intro: Drag the points along the outline and watch d change. What you don't touch gets rewritten exactly as it was — that's why the result stays readable instead of turning into a wall of cubics.
trazos: This icon has {{n}} strokes. Click one to edit its nodes.

leyenda.nodo: node — drag it to move the point
leyenda.manija: bézier handle — bends the curve into it
leyenda.silueta: the icon's real stroke, dimmed so the nodes stay reachable underneath

nodo.pista: Select a node first — then add or delete.

coreografiar.nota: Carries the edited geometry to the Lab with the original choreography: the tracks point at the same shapes, so the animation that already existed runs on the new form.
